messages:
megan: FYI — BlueBridge Healthcare wants to run a hosted POC. projected tokens ~12k/mo. they asked if we can waive the $3k min-charge and give a temporary 40% per-token discount for 2 weeks. need quick answer.

ryan: curious — what's the upside if they convert? size / industry?

megan: early-stage digital clinic, could expand to ~200k tokens/mo if pilot metrics look good. low ARR today. model = redwood-chat-small.

lucas: ops POV: low volume, no infra impact. recommend rate-limit tags and a soft alert if rate >5k tokens/hour.

finance: waive min-charge is OK only with a tracking mechanism. prefer issuing a promo credit vs changing published rates. credits are easier for revenue reporting.

deal-desk: opened ticket DD-9999 to track. please submit pricing-exception worksheet: https://redwood.workflow/requests/DD-9999

contracts-bot: if we waive min-charge, legal asks for a 30- or 60-day pilot addendum and an explicit liability carveout. did they complete the security questionnaire?

megan: they submitted a short SQ, no special compliance requirements. they want minimal paperwork and fast turnaround.

ryan: alternative compromise: 25% token credit for 30 days + waived min-charge for 30 days. that stays within our standard promo playbook.

finance: we can authorize up to $7k in promo credits without exec review. anything above needs rev ops sign-off.

deal-desk: provisional: authorize coupon credit up to $7k, waive min-charge for 30 days, apply 25% token discount via coupon for the first 14 days. Conditions: (1) coupon must be used on invoice, (2) pilot amendment attached, (3) legal signs amendment.

contracts-bot: drafting 1-page pilot addendum now. need legal name + billing address + PO if available.

megan: collecting info from customer, will post here. @infra-bot can you create coupon and set the billing tag?

infra-bot: creating coupon...

infra-bot: coupon created: COUPON-BB-30D-25

infra-bot: details:
```
/coupon create --code COUPON-BB-30D-25 --discount 25% --expires 1890000000 --note "BlueBridge pilot: waive min-charge 30d, 25% token credit 14d"
```

lucas: billing tags added, soft rate limits applied, dashboard alert set.

megan: sent amendment + coupon to customer. they asked if we can make discount automatic instead of coupon (they want seamless experience).

finance: automatic rate table changes are heavier operationally — coupon is preferred. if customer insists we'll escalate, but recommend they use the coupon.

ryan: if customer pushes for a deeper discount, we need a short paid pilot or a 3-month commit.

megan: will update DD-9999 after customer signs. thanks team :white_check_mark:
